fields.title: Reader test: languages and anchors
fields.content:
Text in other scripts and directions, and links within the post. This post has a manual excerpt, and a featured image that isn’t in the post.

Jump to right-to-left text, a percent-encoded anchor, an old-style named anchor, the notes, or an anchor that doesn’t exist.

Right-to-left text

هذه فقرة باللغة العربية، تُكتب من اليمين إلى اليسار. فيها رابط وكلمة English في وسطها.

זוהי פסקה בעברית, שנכתבת מימין לשמאל.

  • یک فهرست به فارسی
  • مورد دوم

Chinese, Japanese and Korean

这是一段中文，用来检查没有空格的文字如何换行。

これは日本語の段落です。ひらがな、カタカナ、漢字が混ざっています。

이것은 한국어 문단입니다.

An old-style anchor, made with <a name>.

A very long word and URL, which shouldn’t make the page scroll sideways: Pneumonoultramicroscopicsilicovolcanoconiosis https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/keeps/going/and/going/without/any/spaces/at/all/to/break/on

Footnotes in the format Markdown makes.1 And a second.2

  1. The first note. ↩
  2. The second note, with a link. ↩

The end.
